mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, f.latency_ms AS latencyMs, f.probe_status AS probeStatus, f.probe_time AS probeTime, f.probe_message AS probeMessage, f.target_weights AS targetWeights, f.mode AS mode, f.chain_strategy AS chainStrategy, f.chain_hops AS chainHops, f.tunnel_ids AS tunnelIds, f.bandwidth_mode AS bandwidthMode, f.bandwidth_up AS bandwidthUp, f.bandwidth_down AS bandwidthDown, f.bandwidth_combined AS bandwidthCombined, f.max_source_ips AS maxSourceIps, f.max_conn_per_ip AS maxConnPerIp, f.expire_at AS expireAt, t.out_node_ids AS outNodeIds, t.chain_node_ids AS chainNodeIds, t.balance_strategy AS balanceStrategy, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id ORDER BY f.created_time DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, f.latency_ms AS latencyMs, f.probe_status AS probeStatus, f.probe_time AS probeTime, f.probe_message AS probeMessage, f.target_weights AS targetWeights, f.mode AS mode, f.chain_strategy AS chainStrategy, f.chain_hops AS chainHops, f.tunnel_ids AS tunnelIds, f.bandwidth_mode AS bandwidthMode, f.bandwidth_up AS bandwidthUp, f.bandwidth_down AS bandwidthDown, f.bandwidth_combined AS bandwidthCombined, f.max_source_ips AS maxSourceIps, f.max_conn_per_ip AS maxConnPerIp, f.expire_at AS expireAt, t.out_node_ids AS outNodeIds, t.chain_node_ids AS chainNodeIds, t.balance_strategy AS balanceStrategy, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.type, t.protocol FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
